display_name: 输入自身重复结构的自参考恢复网络源域训练
description: 利用输入相隔80点的两段重复结构及轻量空洞卷积学习复数混合和全窗残差；固定 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL，相位锚点和输入保护门控；DURA 只在训练后源域对照。
authorization: 用户要求大胆研发 Phase1 恢复网络，不拘泥 DURA，地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；不使用 Phase3。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI Python CPU, MKL-DNN enabled, two CPU threads; SiLU; full-loss zero-gradient source smoke required

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: float32 IQ [2,256], within-input lag80 two 64-point segment complex alignment and learned per-position mixing plus full-window residual; no external IQ dictionary
data.label_map_ref: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL source contract, six classes
data.tx_sets_ref: No TX labels or U_s truth read; frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL clean pseudo predictions and paired IQ guide source training
data.validation_ref: 7840 RX4/6 day3 source IDs for selection, 3921 RX8 day3 heldout; identities previously used in other source experiments, not blind
data.leo_config_ref: Fixed source cache epochs11–13 training, epoch19 source selection

permissions.query_use: Source-only training and candidate selection; no V, test IQ, Phase3; no automatic test predictions
permissions.claim_scope: Single seed, source heldout and Phase1 development previously observed, no independent-blind or real satellite claim

checkpoint.initialization: Random self-reference network; fixed source phase factor and gate; frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL. DURA only loaded after all three checkpoints fixed for source evaluation.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Pinned r02 source dependency 284317bd819df974395d3388b1920a41300937cb; fixed phase checkpoint SHA256 8e9fd8f97a57263be320b8dd57e4dd615fb015d5aab2d276d43864ec8fe8e508
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: Source RX4/6 cache19 vs DURA: per-cell F pseudo-target decrease <= max(1,ceil(.5% valid)), clean IQ <= DURA+.001, impaired IQ <=1.2*DURA+1e-6, aggregate impaired pseudo-correct net >=10; epochs1/2/3 alpha .5/1 threshold .8/.99; RX8 heldout not used

execution.gpu_policy: CPU only; CUDA disabled; two CPU threads, MKL-DNN enabled

execution.stop_rule: Stop only for provenance or role violation, output collision, nonfinite values or technical failure; preserve partial output; never stop for low performance

metrics_plan.scientific_rule: Source F pseudo-target agreement is not ground truth or 3% goal; selected network needs separately fixed inference and full Phase1 test.

rows.method: self-referenced lag80 complex mixing and dilated temporal IQ residual, fixed input gate and source phase factor
rows.purpose: test source improvement and preservation vs DURA before any Phase1 test
rows.seed_notes: Model 2026120254, train shuffle 2026120255; fixed disjoint source splits; caches11–13 train, 19 source eval
rows.scenario: source clean and six simulated impaired scenes
rows.budget_ref: 47143 training IDs, 3 epochs batch32; 7840 RX4/6 validation and 3921 RX8 holdout
